description: Which model a part is assigned, from what the settings list as reachable. Asked after the persona decision and before the effort decision. With nothing listed, or a request that gives no model on the list, the parent's own is passed and the record says why. With one listed, it is assigned without asking.
question: Which reachable model fits this part best?
basis: Version 0 is written from the settings' own descriptions of each model, with no calibration.
subject: the part, with its kind and persona

exact_facts.reachable: the models the reachable list gives the assigned harness, each with its name, description and the effort levels it is offered there
exact_facts.parent: the parent's own model, passed where the list names none or the decision gives none

choice.over: the models the reachable list gives the assigned harness, each with its name, description and the effort levels it is offered there; an answer off the list is never assigned
choice.instructions: This is one part of a piece of delegated work, given as `part`, with its kind and the persona chosen for it. Each option is a model that can run it, with its description. Which model fits doing this part well? Choose the one the part's work needs, not the most capable by default.

outcomes.route: the parent's own model is passed; the record says the settings list none
outcomes.delegated_authority: the parent, by invoking the skill

outcomes.route: it is passed unless the parent overrides
outcomes.delegated_authority: the parent, which an override withdraws

outcomes.when: the Choice returns one on the list
outcomes.route: it is passed unless the parent overrides

outcomes.when: the request fails, times out or answers off the list
outcomes.route: the parent's own model is passed, and the record says why

records: the model passed instead, one on the reachable list

calibration.measure: agreement with labels naming an acceptable model for each part, on the held-out half
calibration.minimum_held_out: 10 parts, with every listed model appearing as an acceptable answer in both halves
